title: Thirty flyers, from the water
logline: The flyer wall from the bay side, from a boat's distance: thirty pale rectangles on gray shingle, a girl's small figure at the end of the row, the dock, the ramp. The wall the way the crab boats see it.

panels.composition: A shingle bait shack seen from the water at a distance with a long row of thirty pale rectangles on its wall and a small figure of a girl at the row's end, a dock and ramp before it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a shingle bait shack seen from the water at a distance with a long row of pale paper rectangles across its wall and a small figure of a girl at the row's end, a dock and plank ramp before it, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The way the crab boats see it.
